claimBoundary: Coverage records technical, documentary and organisational evidence for a pinned AI-system revision. It is not an automatic legal conformity decision or certification.

controls.title: Prohibited-practice screening
controls.description: A released system must have a reviewed intended-purpose screening and must fail closed when a prohibited practice is identified.

responsibilities.responsibility: Enforce versioned screening and block prohibited releases.
Describe and legally assess intended and foreseeable use.

controls.title: Lifecycle risk management
controls.description: Risks, treatments, residual risks, tests and approvals remain versioned throughout the system lifecycle.

responsibilities.responsibility: Version and enforce risk-control and reassessment gates.
Own system risks, treatments and residual-risk decisions.

controls.title: Traceable automatic record keeping
controls.description: Production activity is correlated to the exact system, control, model, policy, tool and oversight revision.

responsibilities.responsibility: Produce tamper-evident bounded logs and offline-verifiable exports.
Choose lawful retention and ensure relevant paths use governed execution.

controls.title: Effective human oversight
controls.description: Competent operators can understand, intervene, stop and review the system through enforced approval and suspension controls.

responsibilities.responsibility: Provide enforceable approval, stop, replay-protection and audit mechanisms.
Assign competent operators and operate the oversight process.

controls.title: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
controls.description: Version-specific evaluation and security thresholds gate release and substantial changes.

responsibilities.responsibility: Run and preserve reproducible evaluation and security gates.
Define use-case thresholds and remediate failures.

controls.title: AI interaction and generated-content transparency
controls.description: Applicable channels expose an accessible, versioned notice and preserve publication evidence.

responsibilities.responsibility: Render and audit configured notices and metadata.
Determine the publication context and provide approved language.

controls.title: Post-market monitoring
controls.description: An active monitoring plan gathers and reviews performance, feedback, drift and compliance signals for the released system.

responsibilities.responsibility: Collect bounded evidence, schedule reviews and surface drift.
Own, review and act on the post-market monitoring plan.

controls.title: Serious-incident handling
controls.description: Incidents preserve causality, deadlines, notifications and corrective-action evidence without making an automatic legal reporting decision.

responsibilities.responsibility: Provide a deadline-aware, immutable incident and CAPA workflow.
Decide reportability and submit to the correct authority within the applicable deadline.
